user_story: As a user, I want to update multiple fields of a task in a single request so that I can edit efficiently.

positive.title: Update multiple fields successfully
steps: Send a request to update task with valid task ID and multiple fields (title, description, due date)
Verify the response status code is 200
Fetch the task using the task ID and ensure that the fields are updated correctly
positive.expected_result: All specified fields are updated successfully

positive.title: Update task with optional fields
steps: Send a request to update a task with only optional fields filled (e.g., tags, priority)
Verify the response status code is 200
Fetch the task using the task ID and ensure that the optional fields are updated correctly

positive.title: Update task fields without changing others
steps: Send a request to update a task with some fields unchanged (title unchanged, description updated)
Verify the response status code is 200
Fetch the task using the task ID and ensure that only the updated fields have changed
positive.expected_result: Only the specified fields are updated, others remain the same

negative.title: Update task with invalid task ID
steps: Send a request to update task with an invalid task ID and multiple fields
Verify the response status code is 404
negative.expected_result: An error message indicating the task ID is not found

negative.title: Update task with invalid data types
steps: Send a request to update a task with fields having invalid data types (e.g., title as number)
Verify the response status code is 400
negative.expected_result: An error message indicating that the field types are incorrect

negative.title: Update task with missing required fields
steps: Send a request to update the task with all required fields missing
Verify the response status code is 400
negative.expected_result: An error message indicating required fields must be provided

edge.title: Update task with maximum allowed field lengths
steps: Send a request to update a task with maximum length for all string fields
Verify the response status code is 200
Fetch the task using the task ID and ensure that the fields are updated correctly
edge.expected_result: Fields are updated successfully with maximum length values

edge.title: Simultaneous rapid updates to a task
steps: Send multiple update requests to the same task ID in rapid succession
Verify the last response status code is 200
Fetch the task and ensure that the final state reflects the most recent update
edge.expected_result: The task is updated based on the last request made
